title: Solar energy technologies for desalination and utilization of hypersaline brines
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,673-692
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01552E, Review Article
Zhen-Wei Wu, Hao-Cheng Yang
This review provides an overview of recent technologies for desalinating and utilizing hypersaline brines powered by solar energy.
